name: Soyuz-33
about: Soyuz-33 (1979-029A), a crewed vehicle (7K-T), launched 1979 Apr 10. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1979 Apr 11), held fixed
